newsitem.title: RUSSIA: PRESS DIGEST - RUSSIA IZVESTIA - MAY 29.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - RUSSIA IZVESTIA - MAY 29.

text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in the May 30 edition of Russia's Izvestia newspaper. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- New bonds which are supposed to solve the acute problem of non-payments are to start circulating on the stock market soon.
- First Deputy Prime Minister Boris Nemtsov was shocked by some details of the electricity tariffs policy carried out in Russia's Far East, a region plagued by an energy crisis.
- Inefficient use of energy costs Russia 180 trillion roubles every year, say experts from Russian Academy of Science.
- Moscow authorities and communist opposition are fighting over a vacant parliament seat which is to be contested in the southern city of Rostov on June 1.
